passages.text: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has power over nature.
The LORD makes storm clouds.
The LORD gives rain.
You should ask the LORD for rain in springtime.
The LORD will give showers of rain to everyone.
The LORD will give crops in the field to each person.
passages.original: שַׁאֲל֨וּ מֵיְהוָ֤ה מָטָר֙ בְּעֵ֣ת מַלְק֔וֹשׁ יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֣ה חֲזִיזִ֑ים וּמְטַר־ גֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם לְאִ֖ישׁ עֵ֥שֶׂב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions; they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort. Therefore the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
passages.sermon:
Idols speak lies.
Diviners see false visions.
They tell dreams that are not true.
They give comfort that is empty.
The people wander like sheep.
They suffer because they have no shepherd.
passages.original: כִּ֧י הַתְּרָפִ֣ים דִּבְּרוּ־ אָ֗וֶן וְהַקּֽוֹסְמִים֙ חָ֣זוּ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַֽחֲלֹמוֹת֙ הַשָּׁ֣וא יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ הֶ֖בֶל יְנַֽחֵמ֑וּן עַל־ כֵּן֙ נָסְע֣וּ כְמוֹ־ צֹ֔אן יַעֲנ֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֵ֥ין רֹעֶֽה׃פ

passages.text: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God cares for His people.
His people are the house of Judah.
God is angry with the shepherds.
The shepherds are the leaders of the people.
God will punish the leaders.
God watches over His flock.
God will make His people strong.
They will be like His royal horse in battle.
passages.original: עַל־ הָֽרֹעִים֙ חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְעַל־ הָעַתּוּדִ֖ים אֶפְק֑וֹד כִּֽי־ פָקַד֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֤וֹת אֶת־ עֶדְרוֹ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה וְשָׂ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כְּס֥וּס הוֹד֖וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow and every ruler together.
passages.sermon:
Judah is the subject of this passage.
Judah will produce the cornerstone.
Judah will provide the tent peg.
Judah will supply the battle bow.
Judah will give every ruler together.
passages.original: מִמֶּ֤נּוּ פִנָּה֙ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יָתֵ֔ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֑ה מִמֶּ֛נּוּ יֵצֵ֥א כָל־ נוֹגֵ֖שׂ יַחְדָּֽו׃

passages.text: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah will be strong like mighty men in battle.
They will trample their enemies in the mud of the streets.
They will fight bravely.
The LORD will be with them.
They will defeat and shame the enemy horsemen.
passages.original: וְהָי֨וּ כְגִבֹּרִ֜ים בּוֹסִ֨ים בְּטִ֤יט חוּצוֹת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנִ֨לְחֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ם וְהֹבִ֖ישׁוּ רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִֽים׃

passages.text: I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them. For I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God will strengthen the house of Judah.
God will save the house of Joseph.
God will restore both houses.
God acts because He has compassion on them.
God will treat them as if He never rejected them.
God is the LORD, their God.
God will answer them.
passages.original: וְגִבַּרְתִּ֣י׀ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יוֹסֵף֙ אוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וְהֽוֹשְׁבוֹתִים֙ כִּ֣י רִֽחַמְתִּ֔ים וְהָי֖וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ זְנַחְתִּ֑ים כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶעֱנֵֽם׃

passages.text: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Ephraim is a tribe of Israel.
Ephraim will be strong like a mighty man.
Their hearts will be glad.
Their gladness will be like the joy that comes from wine.
Their children will see this strength and joy.
Their children will be joyful.
Their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
passages.original: וְהָי֤וּ כְגִבּוֹר֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְשָׂמַ֥ח לִבָּ֖ם כְּמוֹ־ יָ֑יִן וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְשָׂמֵ֔חוּ יָגֵ֥ל לִבָּ֖ם בַּיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them; and they will be as numerous as they once were.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God says, “I will whistle for them.”
I will gather them together.
I have redeemed them.
They will become many again.
They will be as numerous as before.
passages.original: אֶשְׁרְקָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם וַאֲקַבְּצֵ֖ם כִּ֣י פְדִיתִ֑ים וְרָב֖וּ כְּמ֥וֹ רָבֽוּ׃

passages.text: Though I sow them among the nations, they will remember Me in distant lands; they and their children will live and return.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His people Israel.
God says, “I will scatter them among the nations.”
They will live in distant lands.
They will remember Me there.
They and their children will live.
They will return.
passages.original: וְאֶזְרָעֵם֙ בָּֽעַמִּ֔ים וּבַמֶּרְחַקִּ֖ים יִזְכְּר֑וּנִי וְחָי֥וּ אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וָשָֽׁבוּ׃

passages.text: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon until no more room is found for them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people, Israel.
God says, “I will bring them back from Egypt.
I will gather them from Assyria.
I will bring them to the land of Gilead.
I will bring them to Lebanon.
There will not be enough room for them.”
passages.original: וַהֲשִֽׁיבוֹתִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמֵֽאַשּׁ֖וּר אֲקַבְּצֵ֑ם וְאֶל־ אֶ֨רֶץ גִּלְעָ֤ד וּלְבָנוֹן֙ אֲבִיאֵ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves of the sea; all the depths of the Nile will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
passages.sermon:
God will lead His people through the sea of distress.
They will strike the waves of the sea.
All the depths of the Nile will dry up.
God will bring down the pride of Assyria.
God will remove the scepter of Egypt.
passages.original: וְעָבַ֨ר בַּיָּ֜ם צָרָ֗ה וְהִכָּ֤ה בַיָּם֙ גַּלִּ֔ים וְהֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כֹּ֖ל מְצוּל֣וֹת יְאֹ֑ר וְהוּרַד֙ גְּא֣וֹן אַשּׁ֔וּר וְשֵׁ֥בֶט מִצְרַ֖יִם יָסֽוּר׃

passages.text: I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD promises to strengthen His people.
The LORD will make them strong in Him.
They will walk in the name of the LORD.
The LORD declares this.
passages.original: וְגִבַּרְתִּים֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
